quote: Ari is one of the strongest design leaders I've worked with. From a product management perspective, he was an exceptional partner — highly organized, detail-oriented, and deeply thoughtful, while remaining practical and collaborative throughout.

Ari significantly improved our understanding of UX issues within the main product and led our design system initiative. His understanding of design strategy and his communication skills make him an exceptional leader.

Ari is an exceptional product design leader who brings clarity and vision to difficult projects. He built a supportive and collaborative environment, encouraging the team to push creative boundaries and deliver work that mattered.

Ari has been a tremendous mentor throughout my journey as a designer. He offers clear, constructive feedback grounded in real-world experience, with a unique ability to really listen, understand, and provide relevant advice.
